signup.terms.body:
Purpose: description of group operating rules and member obligations.
Main points:

1) Purpose of the group
• This group is for buying and selling Korean products, including merch and cosmetics. Members must follow the rules and act in good faith.

2) Registration and participation
• If needed, it may be stated that the user must be of legal age.
• It should be clarified that by joining the group, the user automatically agrees to these terms.

3) Member obligations
• Members may not post spam, prohibited products, or prohibited materials.
• Members must follow safety rules.
For example: verify sellers and buyers themselves.

4) Payment and delivery
• If desired, it can be clearly stated that the group administrator is not responsible for transactions between users.
• A recommendation to use secure payment methods may also be added.

5) Liability
• The administrator is not responsible for product quality, delivery times, or the actions of group members.

6) Changes to terms
• The administrator has the right to change the rules without prior notice.
signup.step.legalDescription: Please review and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before signing up.
signup.privacy.body:
Purpose: informing users about how their personal data is collected and used.
Main points:

1) Data collection
• It is necessary to specify exactly what data is collected.
For example: name, contact details, chat messages, payment information.

2) Use of data
• Collected data is used only to process sales and contact users.

3) Sharing with third parties
• It is necessary to indicate whether personal data is shared with external services.
Answer: buyers' personal data is not shared with external services.

4) Data security
• We take necessary measures to protect personal data, but cannot guarantee absolute security within Telegram.

5) User rights
• Users have the right to request deletion of their data or to leave the group.

6) Contact
• For all questions regarding personal data:
+10 5164 9833
@danidani_y
(group administrator)
